headline: Oil Heads for Fourth Monthly Gain Amid Escalating Middle East Tensions
summary: Crude oil prices were positioned for another weekly and fourth consecutive monthly gain amid fears of Middle East escalation and Houthi attacks on Saudi infrastructure. Brent crude traded at $116.56 per barrel.
why: Crude oil is a vital global commodity, and sustained price increases heighten global inflationary pressures while impacting energy sector profitability.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and threats to regional energy infrastructure raise concerns over potential supply disruptions.
